customers.evidence: providing life-changing products to patients who need them

employees.evidence: Our leaders’ vision and expertise guide our teams, while their commitment to patients fuels our culture.

environment.evidence: From respected employer practices to environmental stewardship, we are proud of the recognition

community.evidence: We’re constantly working to create solutions that go beyond treating the illness to have a positive impact on patients’ lives, on societies

shareholders.evidence: We’re focused on sustainable growth and addressing the world’s pressing health challenges.

integrity.evidence: Our commitment to ethics and compliance guides each of us, every single day.

innovation.evidence: Research and innovation are the cornerstones of our business.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with a slogan-style opening (People. Passion. Possibilities.). Patients, research and health outcomes dominate; commitments are mostly stated generally rather than quantified. Ethics and Compliance gets a dedicated section. Statistics on headcount, countries and R&D spending are presented as factual business description. Environment and employees appear only briefly.
